title: central-monitoring-hub generate-agent-bundle input
description: Renders a ready-to-run standalone Grafana Alloy configuration and 1-click installer script for sites without NS8.

collector_id.description: Optional explicit collector_id; auto-generated as <customer>-<site>-<platform> when empty.

issue_dedicated_token.description: Mint a dedicated collector-scoped bearer token bound to (customer, site, collector_id) so the bundle embeds a live secret without exposing or rotating the tenant's primary token.
